messages.content:
Питання: Can an employer dismiss an employee while the employee is on sick leave?

Еталонна відповідь: General rule — no: Article 40 of the Labour Code prohibits dismissal on the employer's initiative during temporary incapacity for work (except paragraph 5 of Article 40 and full liquidation). But during martial law Article 5 of Law No. 2136-IX allows it, with the dismissal date set to the first working day after the sick leave ends. A complete answer names both.

Відповідь системи: No, not on the employer's initiative: Article 40 of the Labour Code prohibits dismissal at the employer's initiative during temporary incapacity, with the exception of dismissal under clause 5 (for example, liquidation or staff reduction... note: clause 5 is not specified in the excerpt) and the full liquidation of the enterprise [2][4]. Dismissal of an employee on their own initiative (resignation) is not prohibited during sick leave [1][3]. The source [8] describes a Ministry of Economy position that dismissal on lawful grounds under Articles 40 and 41 is permitted during sick leave, but this contradicts the current text of Article 40 and the ILO Convention No. 158, which states that temporary absence due to illness is not a lawful ground for dismissal [7], so the Labour Code text should be followed [2][4].
